prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pearland, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1290; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim purposes. Can you please state and spell your full name for the record?

A: Sure. It's the name on my policy, I'll leave it at that for the recording.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was stopped at a light on a main road in Pearland, in the right lane, waiting for the signal to change to green.

Q: What happened next?

A: I felt a hard jolt from behind. My head snapped forward and then back into the headrest. I looked in the mirror and saw the front of a silver sedan right on my bumper.

Q: Did you exchange information with the other driver?

A: Yes, we swapped insurance details and phone numbers. He said he got distracted by his phone for a second. He seemed shaken but okay.

Q: Were you taken to a medical facility after the accident?

A: The paramedics checked me at the scene, and then I went to an urgent care clinic later that afternoon because my shoulder was really bothering me.

Q: Can you describe your injuries?

A: My right shoulder is sore and I have trouble lifting my arm above my chest. The pain gets worse at night. I also have a stiff neck and some headaches, but the shoulder is the worst part.

Q: Have you been seeing a doctor since then?

A: Yes, I have two follow-up appointments scheduled with an orthopedic provider and I started some physical therapy twice a week.

Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the accident?

A: Only that I was wearing my seatbelt, and I've been missing work because I can't do my job with one arm working properly. I'm happy to send over my medical records and the clinic bills.

Q: Thank you. We'll follow up with the documents you mentioned. This concludes our recorded statement.
